proof.text: Equip Fin d with the permutation action alpha. Enumerate its finite orbit quotient by Fin m using Fintype.equivFin; choose Quotient.out representatives r(k) and their stabilizers K(k). Every component has a chosen transporter from its representative, and orbit labels are invariant under alpha.

Unfold the equalizer intersection defining the equivariant algebra. Evaluation at representatives defines an H-algebra homomorphism into the product of stabilizer equalizers. If alpha(a)(r(k))=alpha(a-prime)(r(k)), then a-prime inverse times a stabilizes r(k); applying rho(a-prime) to its fixedness equation proves transport independence using rho(ab)=rho(a) composed with rho(b). No assumption rho(1)=id is needed.

For a family b in the product, define f(i)=rho(t(i))(b(o(i))), where t(i) is the chosen transporter and o(i) the orbit label. Transport independence proves equivariance, and stabilizer fixedness proves evaluation of f is b. Conversely equivariance determines every value from the representative, proving injectivity. Apply AlgEquiv.ofBijective and return m and K. This is the already proved affine_torsor_equivariant_orbit_product construction with its unused rho-one assumption and unneeded cardinality bound omitted.

proof_origin.note: Reused the complete constructive proof from AffineTorsorEquivariantOrbitProduct. Its rho-one hypothesis is unused; the same proof establishes the unchanged weaker-hypothesis signature here directly from Mathlib.

title: Equivariant orbit model
statement: For commutative rings H,C with an H-algebra structure, a group G, an action ρ by H-algebra endomorphisms satisfying ρ(ab)=ρ(a)∘ρ(b), and a permutation action α on Fin d, there exist m and subgroups K indexed by Fin m such that the equivariant algebra is H-algebra equivalent to the product of the stabilizer equalizer subalgebras indexed by K.

lean.statement:
theorem equivariant_orbit_model
    (H C : Type u) [CommRing H] [CommRing C] [Algebra H C]
    (G : Type u) [Group G] (ρ : G → C →ₐ[H] C)
    (hρmul : ∀ a b, ρ (a * b) = (ρ a).comp (ρ b))
    (d : ℕ) (α : G →* Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (K : Fin m → Subgroup G),
      Nonempty ((affineTorsorEquivariantAlgebra H C G ρ d α) ≃ₐ[H]
        (∀ k : Fin m,
          (⨅ ζ : K k, AlgHom.equalizer (ρ ζ.val) (AlgHom.id H C) : Subalgebra H C)))
